node.title: Re^4: Regex to extract last 3 components of filename
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Lift it out and adapt it to your own code.

[doc://File::Spec] is a core module. "Copy and paste some code out of a CPAN module" is a last resort at best.

Also be aware of the many goodies in Regexp::Common.

[mod://Regexp::Common] does not handle filename manipulations.
